note: The holdout shapes were pre-registered in case.yaml on 2026-11-14, before any candidate existed. This manifest was frozen on 2026-11-15, after the Triton candidate had already been measured on the RTX 6000D host. It is therefore a post-hoc freeze: the shapes are held out, but the result is reported as a held-out-shape check, not as a blind sealed evaluation. The manifest records configuration only; it contains no measurement results.
control: F.silu(x[:, :H]) * x[:, H:] on the same [B, 2H] buffer

protocol.order: alternating (A,B) on even pairs, (B,A) on odd pairs
protocol.window: CUDA events around one launch, after a flush and a sync
protocol.statistic: paired percentile bootstrap of the per-pair ratio, 20000 resamples, seed 0
